summary: Sunrise Realty Trust filed an 8-K announcing that its board authorized a stock repurchase program of up to $20.0 million of common stock through December 31, 2027. Repurchases are contingent on closing the company's acquisition of Southern Realty Trust Inc.; at least $10.0 million is intended to be repurchased promptly post-close, with the remainder subject to pricing parameters, all via Rule 10b5-1 and 10b-18 plans. The program may be modified or suspended. Watch merger closing timing and actual buyback pace as signals for post-deal capital returns.
